title: CQRS Task-Based UI Architecture
description: A CQRS task-based UI architecture diagram where the frontend captures user intent as explicit commands, submits them asynchronously with optimistic updates, and receives real-time confirmations via WebSocket when the read model is synchronized. This template models the modern UI pattern that replaces CRUD forms with intent-driven commands, enabling responsive user experiences with eventual consistency. Recommended for teams building reactive frontends on CQRS backends.
